messages:
Emily: heads up — noticed a spike in provisional token ledger after a resume path yesterday, looks like prefix tokens got double-applied on reconnect :thinking:
Jia: repro steps?
Emily: user stream reconnects after ~3s network glitch, client resumes with session_id=xyz, router routed to a different backend, ledger shows tokens for both old and new path. minimal logs below:
Emily: ```
INFO Resume session_id=xyz prefix_tokens=74 route=us-east-1-a -> us-east-1-b
BILL provisional +74 stream_tokens session=xyz
BILL finalize +0 reconcile session=xyz
```
Matt: could be a race between provisional capture and finalization. if the finalize ACK is dropped we keep provisional, then the resumed path re-credits when it replays the prefix
Anya: another angle — prefetch/kv cache eviction could cause the resumed backend to re-emit the prefix as a toolcall when it doesn’t find KV, so you get prefix charged as toolcall tokens in addition to stream tokens
Kevin: @Emily can you paste the router headers from that trace? curious if sticky_session was set
Emily: headers: `x-routesession=xyz, x-sticky=false` — looks like we intentionally had non-sticky routing for this tenant
Jia: sticky=false explains it — resume landing on different instance will recreate provisional entries
Matt: short-term mitigation: dedupe provisional credits by (session_id + prefix_hash) before applying to ledger; cheap guard and low risk
Anya: agree, and add a telemetry counter provisional_credits_per_session to detect bursts
Kevin: I can run an experiment: flip sticky=true for cust_42 on staging and replay the trace
infra-bot: deploy-notice: toggled router sticky flag on staging for customer cust_42 at 2026-03-19T18:06Z
Emily: ran the test on staging — sticky=true removes the double provisional credit; ledger shows single provisional then finalize as expected
Jia: next steps: 1) add provisional_id attachment from router so dedupe can be deterministic; 2) reconciler job to expire orphan provisional entries after 30s and mark them as reconciled
Matt: also want a console dashboard panel: provisional vs finalized tokens per minute, and an alert when the gap > 10% for 5m
Anya: and a small bug fix: toolcall attribution should only bill as toolcall if kv_lookup_miss == true; otherwise treat it as stream prefix re-send
Kevin: I'll file an infra ticket and a console UX follow-up to make provisional state visible in the billing view
Emily: thanks — filing the incident ticket with traces and the staging replay link now
Emily: /me files ticket
